land.doc.title: Weekly meeting
land.doc.callout: Small notes make better work.One more step today, for a better team together.
land.f1.title: Organized into blocks
land.f1.body:
Markdown from your AI is
sorted into headings, lists,
tables and callouts automatically.
land.f2.title: Share with one link
land.f2.body:
No complicated setup:
a public page link is all
it takes to share with anyone.
land.f3.title: AI keeps the record
land.f3.body:
Meetings, notes and ideas
are written by AI in markdown
and turned into tidy pages right away.
land.pub.title: Public pages and blogs
land.pub.lead:
Publish a page
and it becomes a blog.
land.pub.sub:
No invite, no sign-up:
anyone can read your thoughts
on a beautiful page.
land.blog.title: Q3 retrospective
land.blog.author: Minji Kim
land.blog.p1:
Q3 went by so fast.
It was a time to build, learn and grow a lot together with the team.
land.blog.p2:
We heard user feedback up close,
and became confident our direction is right.
land.blog.p3: In Q4 I want to focus more and get even better results.
land.price.title: Start the way that suits you.
land.price.lead: Use Acard as open source or in the cloud.
land.price.selfDesc: Open source · runs on your server · installs with Supabase
land.price.cloudDesc: No install · easy sharing and public pages · automatic backups
land.foot.desc:

Acard, a tool for better notes.

onb.s3.tip1: Check that you pressed Allow in the Acard tab that opened in your browser
onb.s3.tip2: Restart your agent and reconnect acard from /mcp
onb.s3.tip3: Make sure a company proxy or VPN is not blocking notes.example.com
